What you receive

One skill at a time. Practiced in your real life.

Kelsey uses the Precision Nutrition habit-based approach to help you learn, experiment, and adjust rather than chase a perfect menu.

01 · LEARN

Short daily lessons

Useful nutrition concepts in manageable pieces, connected to choices you are already making.

02 · PRACTICE

Weekly habit goals

A focused action—such as building a balanced breakfast—rather than changing everything at once.

03 · ADJUST

Coach check-ins

Direct support and regular video conversations help turn obstacles into the next practical step.

Within scope

Coaching, not medical nutrition therapy.

Kelsey is Precision Nutrition Level 1 Certified and a certified personal trainer. Nutrition coaching focuses on general education, behavior change, planning, and accountability.

If you need diagnosis, treatment, therapeutic diets, eating-disorder care, or management of a medical condition, Kelsey will encourage you to work with a physician or registered dietitian.

Read the health disclaimer
Common questions

Nutrition coaching, without the mystery.

Will Kelsey give me a meal plan?

The program is built around skills and habits rather than a rigid menu. You will learn how to create meals that work with your preferences, goals, and routine.

Do I have to count calories or macros?

Not automatically. Tracking can be useful for some people, but it is not the only way to make progress. Kelsey will choose tools that fit the person and goal.

Is online nutrition coaching available outside Michigan?

Yes. General nutrition coaching is delivered online for clients throughout the United States, within Kelsey's professional scope.

Can I combine nutrition and fitness coaching?

Yes. The combined plan connects workouts and nutrition so both parts support the same goal and schedule.
